analogy.rationale: EGFR inhibitors block receptor tyrosine kinase signaling through RAS-RAF-MEK-MAPK and PI3K-AKT, so other tyrosine kinase inhibitors and downstream MAPK-pathway inhibitors should yield the most similar transcriptional responses. VEGFR inhibition is included because several EGFR-class drugs also hit KDR/angiogenesis-related kinases.
